news.buyback: {ceo} announces a share buyback. Shareholders applaud.
news.upgrade: A star analyst raises their target on {name}: “strong buy, maybe even very strong”.
news.newProduct: {name} unveils a new product. Nobody knows what it does, but there’s AI in it.
news.index: {name} joins a prestigious index. Index funds buy without thinking.
news.courted: Rumor: {name} is being courted by an industry giant.
news.bestYear: {ceo} promises “the best year in our history” on live TV.
news.recall: {name} recalls 2 million products over “a slight risk of explosion”.
news.antitrust: The competition authority opens an investigation into {name}.
news.insiderSale: {ceo} quietly sells a big chunk of their shares. Pure coincidence, surely.
news.downgrade: An analyst downgrades {name}: “we no longer understand their strategy”.
news.strike: General strike at {name}. The coffee machine is said to be the cause.
news.cyberattack: {name} hit by a cyberattack: the password was “admin1234”.
news.badTweet: {ceo} tweets something regrettable. The PR team resigns.

takeoverSold.body: Your {qty} shares are bought back at {offer}: +{amount}.

bankrupt.body: Your {qty} shares are now worthless (about {amount} gone up in smoke).

bankClosed.title: Account closed
bankClosed.body: {bank} closed your account for insufficient funds. Back to {free}.

creationLive.title: {name} is live!
creationLive.body: {kind, select, POOL {Your pool now accepts miners. You collect its fee.} CRYPTO {Your crypto is listed. Your share arrives over {days} days, royalties from the first trade.} other {Your company is listed. Your share arrives over {days} days, royalties from the first trade.}}

flat-tax.title: {event}
flat-tax.body: Flat tax on your capital gains: −{amount}.

tax-refund.title: {event}
tax-refund.body: The taxman refunds you {amount}. Don’t get used to it.

bank-hack.title: {event}
bank-hack.body: {bank} hacked: you lose {amount}{shield, plural, =0 {} other { (#% covered by your bank)}}.

bank-run.title: {event}
bank-run.body: {bank} went bankrupt: you lose {amount} above the deposit guarantee.

inheritance.title: {event}
inheritance.body: A rich uncle you never met leaves you {amount}.

mining.welcome: You got your bedroom back and an old wooden crate. Your farm starts here.
mining.breaker: Breaker tripped! {facility} goes over {max, number} kW. All its rigs are shut down.
mining.powerCut: Power cut: not enough cash to pay for electricity. All your rigs are stopped.
mining.fire: FIRE in {rig} ({temp, number} °C). Every part is burnt to a crisp.
mining.break: {part} gave out in {rig}{worn, select, yes { (fully worn)} other {}}. Rig stopped.
mining.scam: EXIT SCAM: {pool} vanished with your {qty} pending {symbol}. The site now shows a “Down for maintenance” page.

flat-tax.title: Flat tax
flat-tax.description: The State takes {rate, number}% of capital gains realized over the last 24 h. Sell before or after? Your call.

wealth-tax.title: Tax on the rich
wealth-tax.description: Progressive tax on net worth: 2% above $50k, 5% above $200k, 10% above $1M. Paid in cash.

tax-audit.title: Tax audit
tax-audit.description: The taxman takes an interest in customers of “discreet” banks. One in two gets fined {rate, number}% of their cash.

tax-refund.title: Tax refund
tax-refund.description: Calculation error at the treasury: {rate, number}% of the taxes paid this week are refunded.

bank-hack.title: Bank hack
bank-hack.description: {bank} got hacked. Its customers lose between {min, number} and {max, number}% of their cash (minus the bank’s protection).

wallet-hack.title: Wallet theft
wallet-hack.description: A hacker drains {rate, number}% of a crypto from {count, plural, one {# random player} other {# random players}}. Shouldn’t have clicked that link.

bank-run.title: Bank failure
bank-run.description: {bank} goes bankrupt. Deposits above the guarantee lose {rate, number}%. Customers are moved to the free bank.

airdrop.title: Surprise airdrop
airdrop.description: Free {symbol} giveaway: about ${usd, number} for every active player.

inheritance.title: Inheritance from a rich uncle
inheritance.description: {count, plural, one {# random player inherits} other {# random players inherit}} ${min, number} to ${max, number}. Condolences and congratulations.

exceptional-dividend.title: Special dividend
exceptional-dividend.description: {symbol} holders receive {rate, number}% of their position’s value in cash.

bull-run.title: Bull run
bull-run.description: Euphoria everywhere: the whole market goes into hype mode (+{pct, number}% fair value).

crash.title: Crash
crash.description: Panic on the markets: everything falls (−{pct, number}% fair value).

elon-tweet.title: Elon tweeted
elon-tweet.description: A 3 am tweet sends {symbol} soaring {pct, number}%.

rug-pull.title: Organized rug pull
rug-pull.description: The {symbol} devs ran off with the cash box. −{pct, number}%.

heat-wave.title: Heat wave
heat-wave.description: +{ambient, number} °C in every facility for 12 h. Poorly cooled rigs are going to suffer.

energy-crisis.title: Energy crisis
energy-crisis.description: Electricity costs {mult, number}× more for 24 h.

gpu-shortage.title: GPU shortage
gpu-shortage.description: Hardware costs {mult, number}× more (buying and reselling) for 24 h. Good news for those who already own some.

green-subsidy.title: Green mining subsidy
green-subsidy.description: Electricity is half price for 12 h. Turn everything on!

solar-storm.title: Solar storm
solar-storm.description: Parts break down {mult, number}× more often for 4 h.
